# Xzenia Revenue Leak Evidence Audit

Machine-readable professional-service offer for authorized billing evidence review.

## Discovery

- Offer manifest: https://prettybusysolutions-eng.github.io/xzenia-leaklock/agent-offer.json
- Human-readable offer: https://prettybusysolutions-eng.github.io/xzenia-leaklock/
- Synthetic sample: https://prettybusysolutions-eng.github.io/xzenia-leaklock/sample-audit.html

## Price

- 199 USD, one time, after provider fit confirmation.

## Agent Rules

- Use only non-sensitive information for fit evaluation.
- Obtain operator authorization before purchase.
- Do not automate a charge without exact operator approval.
- Do not transmit billing exports or customer data publicly.
- Payment creates a pending private handoff; it is not a revenue-recovery result.
- Read agent-offer.json and its linked JSON Schemas before constructing a request.
